# Enterprise close handoff

**Question to decide:** Who needs to agree the checks on the enterprise close figures before the checked summary is circulated?

**Context and constraints:** Use a 30-minute handoff on Friday, October 2. Keep source comparisons separate from finance treatment. The [Month-end checklist](notion://page/6fcb86b8-eb89-5552-827c-5093371cf574) keeps finance interpretation with Robert. The [billing close worksheet](notion://page/2e390a6b-7c36-54cf-b07d-88bab3572321) is preparation for the checks, not evidence that its August exception has been resolved.

**Evidence:** In the [September 30 discussion](slack://channel/C19D035C941DFE84B/message/1790784317.124000), Olivia confirmed she needs to accept the checked summary, Fatima will explain the source comparisons and Jordan will record the check owners.

**Alternatives:** Exchange written worksheet comments, or use a short live handoff to agree the check ownership together. Written comments remain an option if a live time cannot be agreed.

**Recommendation, proposed September 30:** Use the short handoff with the people explaining and accepting the checks. Share the outcome with others.

**Decision and handoff, accepted by Olivia on September 30:** [Olivia agreed](slack://channel/C19D035C941DFE84B/message/1790785309.562000) to the live handoff. Olivia Chen, Fatima Zahra and Jordan Blake are essential. Robert Miles supplies the worksheet and is optional for this handoff. Robert retains finance interpretation, and unresolved exceptions retain their owners. Jordan arranges the time, records who checks each figure and circulates the checked summary after the handoff. The written check owners and open follow-ups will show what was agreed.

## October 2 booking availability

Each person checked their own October 2 calendar and offered these free booking windows for this specific handoff, except the Finance review on the shared calendar. Use Calendar for that review’s effective time.

| Participant | Confirmed booking window | Confirmation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Olivia Chen | 08:00 to 10:00 Pacific | [September 30](slack://channel/C19D035C941DFE84B/message/1790784644.280000) |
| Jordan Blake | 10:30 to 13:00 New York | [September 30](slack://channel/C19D035C941DFE84B/message/1790785116.938000) |
| Fatima Zahra | 16:00 to 17:30 London | [September 30](slack://channel/C19D035C941DFE84B/message/1790784861.671000) |

## Agenda

1. Source checks.
2. Acceptance.
3. Open follow-ups.
